standard.summary: 使用 Triton 编写的融合 CUDA 内核替代 PyTorch 原生操作，覆盖 LoRA 计算、QKV 投影和 AdaLN 调制，减少 kernel launch 开销。
standard.effect: triton_ops_inject_lora 替换 LoRA 的 down/up 矩阵乘法为融合 kernel。triton_ops_inject_qkv 融合 Q/K/V 投影。triton_ops_inject_adaln 融合 AdaLN 调制。triton_ops_fp32_backward 在 backward 中保持 FP32 精度。
standard.whenToUse: 追求极致训练速度时。需要 Triton 环境支持。
standard.avoidWhen: Triton 环境不完整时。默认关闭（triton_ops_enabled=False）。

standard_en.summary: Replaces native PyTorch operations with fused CUDA kernels written in Triton, covering the LoRA computation, the QKV projection and AdaLN modulation, which cuts kernel-launch overhead.
standard_en.effect: triton_ops_inject_lora replaces LoRA's down/up matrix multiplications with a fused kernel. triton_ops_inject_qkv fuses the Q/K/V projections. triton_ops_inject_adaln fuses AdaLN modulation. triton_ops_fp32_backward keeps FP32 precision in the backward pass.
standard_en.whenToUse: When chasing the last of the training speed. It needs a working Triton environment.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When the Triton environment is incomplete. Off by default (triton_ops_enabled=False).

advanced.principle: Triton 是 OpenAI 开发的高性能 GPU 编程框架。Lulynx 用 Triton 编写了三个融合 kernel：(1) LoRA fusion: 将 x·A^T·B^T + scale 合并为单次 kernel 调用；(2) QKV fusion: 将 Q/K/V 三个线性投影融合为一次 GEMM；(3) AdaLN fusion: 将 scale/shift/gate 调制合并。这减少了 kernel launch 次数和显存中间分配。
advanced.intervention: 替换对应的 PyTorch nn.Linear forward 为 Triton kernel 调用。
advanced.expectedImpact: LoRA fusion 提速约 15-25%。QKV fusion 提速约 10-20%。
advanced.tradeoffs: 需要 CUDA + Triton 环境。可能与 torch.compile 冲突。

advanced_en.principle: Triton is OpenAI's high-performance GPU programming framework. Lulynx wrote three fused Triton kernels: (1) LoRA fusion: merges x·A^T·B^T + scale into a single kernel call; (2) QKV fusion: fuses the Q/K/V linear projections into one GEMM; (3) AdaLN fusion: merges the scale/shift/gate modulation. This reduces kernel launch count and intermediate VRAM allocations.
advanced_en.intervention: Replaces the corresponding PyTorch nn.Linear forwards with Triton kernel calls.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: LoRA fusion speeds up about 15-25%. QKV fusion about 10-20%.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Requires a CUDA + Triton environment. May conflict with torch.compile.
